author: Animalogic
description:
The fossa is one of the strangest and most misunderstood predators in the world. They evolved in Madagascar, a land without cats, and turned themselves into one of the apex predator of the island. So how does a bear-faced, cat-cosplaying civet manage to be the terror of lemurs? Watch to find out!
